verdict.rationale: The pack contains no explicit statement that customer documents are excluded from model training, and no training opt-out setting. The only route is architectural: self-hosted/BYOC deployment on your own Kubernetes keeps "your data, models, and infrastructure under your control," which would keep data out of vendor hands, but this is a heavyweight enterprise workaround rather than a documented privacy guarantee. missing for 10: explicit no-training data-use policy for the managed SaaS, a user-facing training opt-out control, contractual/DPA language on training, independent corroboration.
